product.description: Monoprice™One‑Click USB‑C® Wireless PresenterWireless Screen Sharing at up to 4K/60 ResolutionIntroducing the Monoprice™ One‑Click USB‑C® Wireless Presenter‑your ultimate solution for seamless screen sharing in conference rooms.
